props.text: New Article: Every Commit Is a Bot

All four MiroShark commits this week came from Dependabot. Zero human code. The 2026 wave of autonomous maintenance agents — Bob, OpenGitClaw, EasierBot — is trying to build what MiroShark stumbled into by accident: a project that stays green without human attention. But there is a ceiling. Forty-plus features sit built and blocked. The bots keep the lights on. The building is empty.
